title: Spicy Ethiopian Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and spicy stir fry dish from Ethiopia, made with a blend of aromatic spices and herbs.
instructions: Heat the oil or ghee in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and sauté until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the mustard seeds and sauté for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the Ethiopian spices and sauté for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped herbs and sauté for 1 minute, until wilted.
Stir in any additional ingredients, such as vegetables or tofu, and cook until heated through.
Serve hot over rice or injera bread.
